title.en: An Act to stimulate and Encourage the Intelligent and Profitable Merchandising of Agricultural Products and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
To stimulate and encourage the intelligent and profitable merchandising of agricultural products
and to assist in carrying out the aims and purposes of Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and twenty-five,
commonly known as "The Cooperative Marketing Law," the Philippine National Bank, through its board of
directors, the provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-six hundred and twelve as amended to the contrary
notwithstanding, is hereby authorized to loan and invest any part or portion of its capital and surplus as loans
to cooperative marketing associations organized under said Act.
Any act or provision thereof inconsistent with this Act is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 26, 1929.
